snippet.title: Drawmi: Creature Collector Announcement Trailer - A World of Creatures You Draw, Collect, and Battle
snippet.description:
Drawmi: Creature Collector is coming to Steam Next Fest in October!
Wishlist now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5126230/Drawmi_Creature_Collector
And watch for playtests and the demo!

Drawmi is a new “draw it yourself” game franchise by Doonamai. Whether you, your friends, or your kids enjoy drawing, these games are built to express creativity and bring your drawings to life.

Drawmi: Creature Collector is a premiere game of the series. A creature-collecting auto-battler where every creature in your team is something you drew yourself. Sketch a new species into existence, find it living in the wild, and out-position rival tamers to earn your Scribble Fighting art degree.

Follow the entire Drawmi Series at: https://drawmigames.com
